common.language.label.description: Label of the site language picker.

common.language.auto.description: Picker option that follows the browser; {language} is the detected language's own name.

common.language.hint.description: Help text under the language picker; keep ?lang= verbatim.

common.units.label.description: Label of the distance units picker.

common.units.auto.description: Units option that follows the site default (metric).

common.units.areaKm2.description: An area in square kilometres; {value} is already a formatted number.

common.units.areaSquareMiles.description: An area in square miles; {value} is already a formatted number.

common.timeZone.auto.description: Time-zone option that follows the device; {timeZone} is an IANA name such as Europe/Paris.

common.machineBanner.link.description: Link in the machine-translation banner to the how-to-help page.

outreach.title.description: Title of the one-time popup shown to visitors from a country whose language we are adding.

outreach.body.description: Popup body: MeshOMatic wants to expand to the visitor's area and asks for help fine-tuning translations.

outreach.helpGithub.description: Link to help with translations on GitHub.

outreach.helpDiscord.description: Link to join the MeshOMatic Discord.

outreach.switchTo.description: Button that switches the whole site to the visitor's language (only shown when the site supports it).

outreach.dismiss.description: Button that closes the popup for good.

outreach.machineNote.description: Small note that the popup text is a machine translation.

common.machineBanner.close.description: Accessible name of the X button that closes the machine-translation banner.
